correctness.rationale: From the tetrahedral four-face Cauchy formula, exact shadow area is max(4 max|u_i|,2 sum|u_i|), and triangular silhouette is equivalent to sum|u_i|>2 max|u_i|. The eight disjoint triangular normal cones are spherical triangles. Each cap centered on a cube diagonal at threshold s intersects its cone in a cap minus three disjoint congruent spherical segments. Spherical cosine rule and Gauss-Bonnet yield the exact G(s), and tangency at s*=4 sqrt(2/3) yields the 3/2 correction with coefficient 6/pi*(2/3)^(1/4). The packaged verifier directly checks planar hull counts/areas, spherical segment quadrature, 1.9 million sampled orientations, and known first two marked moments. Sampling is not used as proof.
